prompt: 300mm from a low rise over flat Fenland: a village of a dozen lit cottages and a church in the middle distance. On the far horizon, edge to edge, stands an unbroken rank of machine silhouettes: port cranes, pylons and wind turbines, all leaning forward like a wall of giants, lit from below by a band of field fire. Substations along their line burst white-blue, and the nearer turbines spin out of control. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
